g.text: PV of all tax, discounted at the fixed normal rate
Hypothetical comparison; flat tax rates and a common pre-tax total return across saving vehicles
T08 Different investment scales confound above-normal PV comparisons
Source: 01_compare.R. Initial labour $100k; tax 30%; inflation 2.5%; normal real return 3%; nominal
return/allowance/discount 5.575%. House/business have no current payouts. Company relief and usable credits assumed under
RRA. GST initially invests $100k; income-tax cases invest $70k. This is NOT a matched-project RRA/cash-flow equivalence
